heading.title: Hearing of the suit and examination of witnesses

article.title: Power of Court to inspect.
article.content:
18Power of Court to inspect.

Order 18, Rule 18
The Court may at any stage of a suit inspect any property or thing concerning which any question may arise 5[and where the Court inspects any property or thing it shall, as soon as may be practicable, make a memorandum of any relevant facts observed at such inspection and such memorandum shall form a part of the record of the suit].

5 Ins. by s. 69, ibid. (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
